title: Seen Everywhere
story:
A father and his little daughter were walking through a busy city.

Cars moved fast.

People rushed everywhere.

Tall buildings blocked most of the sky.

The girl held her father’s hand and looked around.

“Where is God?” she asked.

The father smiled.

He pointed to a small tree growing through a crack in the pavement.

“Look there,” he said.

They walked a little further.

A bird flew across the narrow street.

“Look again,” he said.

Then they stopped at a signal.

The sun reflected brightly on a glass building.

The light shone into their eyes.

The girl paused.

Slowly, she smiled.

“I see Him,” she said softly.

In life, we often think we need a perfect place to see God.

Mountains.

Nature.

Silence.

But God’s glory is everywhere.

In small details.

In everyday moments.

Even in the busiest places.

We just need to notice.

Because creation is always pointing to Him.
life_lesson:
God’s glory is not limited to special places.

You can see Him in everyday moments, if you pay attention.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for revealing Yourself through creation.

Open my eyes to see You in the small things around me.

Help me not to miss Your presence in my daily life.

Teach me to notice Your glory everywhere.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Do you only look for God in special moments?

What small things around you show His presence?

How can you become more aware of Him today?
verse:
The heavens declare the glory of God.
The skies proclaim the work of His hands.
